dslApply.text:
#!sdd 1
diagram "Flows"
seq checkout "Checkout" {
  autonumber
  actor web as "Web client" model=m_web
  participant api model=m_api
  database db
  web -> api: POST /order
  alt stock ok
    api ->> db: insert
    note right of db: saved
  else sold out
    api --> web: no
  end
  loop every 5s
    api -x db: ping
  end
}
seq "Second flow" {
  a -> b: hi
}

dslApply.text:
#!sdd 1
diagram "Machine"
states {
  initial start
  state idle "Idle" activity="entry / start timer
exit / stop"
  state active "Active" {
    state a1 "A1"
    region
    state a2 "A2"
    history h
    entryPoint ep
    exitPoint xp "Done"
  }
  choice c
  fork f vertical
  join j
  final end
  start -> idle
  idle -> ep "go [ok] / run"
  ep -> a1
  a2 -> xp
  active -> c
  c -> end "done"
}

activity
dslApply.text:
#!sdd 1
diagram "Order"
activity {
  initial start
  lane cust "Customer" {
    action order "Place order"
    object o "Order" state=placed
  }
  lane shop "Shop" orient=h {
    action check
    decision d
    fork f vertical
    send s "Notify"
    accept a "Reply"
  }
  note n "retry twice"
  final end
  flowFinal ff
  start -> order
  order -> check
  check -> d
  d -> end "[in stock]"
  d -> ff "[out of stock]"
  f -> s
  s -> a "[sent]"
  n -- check
}

#!sdd 1
diagram "Domain \"model\""

seq seq1 "Checkout" {
  autonumber
  actor web as "Web"
  participant api
  database db as "DB"
  web -> api: POST /order
  alt stock ok
    api ->> db: insert
    note right of db: saved
  else else
    api --> web: sold out
  end
}

classes {
  abstract class Animal {
    + name: string
    + speak(loud, times)
  }
  class Dog {
    breed: string
  }
  interface Pet
  class Loop1
  class Loop2
  class Lonely

  Dog --|> Animal
  Loop1 --|> Loop2
  Loop2 --|> Loop1
  Dog -- Pet
}
